statement.zh: 代尔拜赫里哈特谢普苏特神庙上层平台西北端见 Naville《代尔拜赫里神庙》I 图版（1895，EEF Memoir 13）。
statement.en: At Deir el-Bahari, the north-western end of the upper platform of Hatshepsut’s temple is documented in plates in Naville The Temple of Deir el Bahari Part I (1895, EEF Memoir 13).

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: temple platform first.
